title: Celebrate Conic Content Paint
description: When elements celebrate (data-celebrated=true), paint emphasized chrome (label text, icons, drag handles) with the same spinning three-brand conic gradient as the celebrate border ring—not solid foreground gray. Scope to leaf controls, not window/dock shell descendants.
summary: Celebrate content paint now shares the spinning three-brand conic with the border ring. Refactored celebrate CSS: --celebrate-conic on [data-celebrated=true] host, spin on host and burst on ::after, inheritable --celebrate-border-angle, silhouette fill uses var(--celebrate-conic). Added CelebrateContent region painting leaf control chrome (buttons, toggles, tabs, tree rows, introduction labels, pane chrome): text via background-clip, stroke icons and drag handles via destination-in blend; celebrated drag handles override hover-scope emphasized color. Window/dock shells excluded. Extended celebrateElements vitest for CSS contract.
